name: Inference Works – Delivery Date for WooCommerce
author: InferenceWorks

sections.description:
Display estimated dispatch and delivery dates. Store owners must configure realistic handling and transit times. No carrier integrations or cookies. Free sends no data outside your store. Source includes an optional Freemius SDK; with empty product placeholders it does not initialize. License activation, when configured, uses Freemius and its privacy terms.

Optional Pro: method/zone transit times, product/category/shipping-class handling rules, weekly cutoffs, multiple breaks, PL/EN message templates, and DE/CZ/SK/AT/LT destination holidays. Germany covers nationwide holidays only. Unknown destinations use weekdays without a local holiday calendar. Dispatch still follows the Polish store calendar.

Terms: https://inferenceworks.eu/terms/
Privacy: https://inferenceworks.eu/en/privacy/

Source code

The plugin includes its human-readable JavaScript and CSS source files. These are the same files WordPress loads; no minifier, bundler, transpiler or compilation step is required.

  • assets/admin.js and assets/admin.css: settings and date preview.
  • assets/engine.js: date calculations shared with the PHP implementation.
  • assets/frontend.js and assets/frontend.css: storefront dates and countdown.
  • assets/blocks-cart.js: cart block updates.
  • blocks/delivery-date/editor.js: delivery date block editor.

The Pro/Source edition also includes its readable source files in includes/Pro/assets/. Third-party licenses and source references are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Freemius SDK source, when bundled by Freemius: https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Activate this plugin and open Inference Works → Delivery Date.
sections.faq:
Are promised dates removed on uninstall?

No. Order promise metadata is retained as part of order history. Plugin settings are deleted.
sections.changelog:
0.2.4

  • Include readable JavaScript and CSS throughout the plugin and document the source file locations; no compilation is required.
  • Correct the WordPress.org contributor username.

0.2.3

  • All texts use English source strings with WordPress translation functions (admin, storefront, block, order section and emails), ready for translate.wordpress.org. Holiday names are translatable.
  • Storefront script translations now load (the text domain was passed as a variable and could not be extracted).

0.2.2

  • Activating the Pro version now switches the free version off automatically, and only one edition runs at a time.
  • Uninstalling one edition keeps shared data while the other edition is still installed; the free version cleans up its own data when it is the last one removed.

0.2.1

  • Align the paid plugin slug and premium suffix with the Freemius product configuration.
  • Make the Pro uninstall run through the Freemius uninstall hook.

0.2.0

  • Add optional Pro shipping method and zone lead times, preparation rules, weekly cutoffs, multiple dispatch breaks, message templates and destination holiday calendars.
  • Keep Free independent of licensing and retain order promises on uninstall.

0.1.0

  • Initial Free version.
